method: Settlement-time allocation, NOT final beneficiary profit. Across every included transaction, native+ERC20 transfers balance by asset; gas splits into burn and priority. WETH deposit/withdrawal reserve liability uses contra token balance at WETH address. Market <=5min benchmarks with Aave fallback for missing lead assets, matching separate scenario. Other unpriced tokens retained explicitly; priced components alone conserve but are not full wealth. Pool inventory gains precede later arbitrage; lending asset outflows exclude offsetting loan claims. No sum with downstream profits or proposer payouts.
